# Home Mortgage Loans: term, rate type, eligible occupancy and loans per program

This quick-reference card covers the six Home Mortgage Loans programs of Piedmont Crescent Bank (PCB). For each program it states the scheduled term, whether the note rate is fixed or adjustable, the occupancy types the program accepts, and the most loans of that program a single customer may hold.

## Parameters by program

| Program | Scheduled term (months) | Rate type | Eligible occupancy types | Most loans of this program per customer |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 360 | Fixed | Primary residence | 1 |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 360 | Fixed | Primary residence | 1 |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 360 | Fixed | Primary residence, second home, investment | 3 |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 180 | Fixed | Primary residence, second home, investment | 3 |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | 360 | Adjustable | Primary residence, second home | 2 |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 360 | Fixed | Primary residence, second home | 2 |

## Meaning of each column

1. **Scheduled term** is the program's term, stated in whole months.
2. **Rate type** is either fixed or adjustable.
3. **Eligible occupancy types** lists the ways the borrower may occupy the property securing a loan of that program: as a primary residence, as a second home, or as an investment property.
4. **Most loans of this program per customer** is the largest number of loans of that same program the customer may have in applied, active, delinquent or forbearance status. A loan in applied status is an application that has been recorded but has not yet closed.

## Points of judgement

- **Which program has a 15-year term?** Only the Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage, at 180 months. The other five programs run 360 months, which is 30 years.
- **Which programs accept an investment property?** Only the Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage and the Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage.
- **Which program has an adjustable rate?** Only the 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage; the other five programs are fixed-rate.
- **Hypothetical case.** A customer already has one FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage loan in active status. The FHA program allows at most 1 loan of that program in applied, active, delinquent or forbearance status, so a second FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage loan would exceed that number.
- **Hypothetical case.** A customer has two Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage loans, one active and one paid off. Only the active loan is in one of the four counted statuses, so the customer holds 1 counted Jumbo loan against a program maximum of 2.
